newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria offers 40 bln levs 3-mth T-bills Monday.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria offers 40 bln levs 3-mth T-bills Monday.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry will offer on Monday 40 billion levs of three-month discount T-bills with no minimum acceptable price set in advance, the central bank said.
The central bank also said the finance ministry had cut the share of non-competitive bids to five percent of the total par of the issue from 30 percent previously.

"This would give the banks a greater opportunity to place their funds through competitive orders where the bids are approved on the basis of the prices offered," a finance ministry official told Reuters.
Non-competitive orders are approved on the basis of the time they were placed, the official added.
